findings.heading: Flexdashboard
findings.proposition: The English states that the flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files, not example datasets, so they are NOT part of the appliedepidata package and must be downloaded directly from Github; the French says only 'below are links to the file associated with the page'.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader who has installed appliedepidata may search for the dashboard files with get_data()/save_data() or list_data(), find nothing, and conclude the package install failed, instead of understanding that these files only ever come from the Github links.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Recherche des contacts
findings.proposition: The English states 'This data is not part of appliedepidata'; the French sentence drops that clause entirely and goes straight from the Go.Data attribution to the download links.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader looking for the contact-tracing data will expect it inside appliedepidata (the package the whole section is organised around) and will waste time in search_data()/list_data() before falling back to the manual .rds download links.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Recherche des contacts
findings.proposition: The French points the Go.Data source link at https://github.com/WorldHealthOrganization/godata/raw/main/analytics/r-reporting, whereas the English points at https://github.com/WorldHealthOrganization/godata/tree/master/analytics/r-reporting; the French URL uses the raw-content path and the 'main' branch rather than the browsable tree path on 'master'.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader clicking the Go.Data reference gets a raw-content/branch URL rather than the browsable directory listing the English sends readers to, so they cannot see the r-reporting folder contents the sentence is citing.

findings.heading: Case linelist / Liste de cas (linelist)
findings.proposition: The French adds 'Cela garantit que vous n'aurez qu'un nettoyage minimal a faire apres avoir importe les donnees dans R' (this ensures you will have only minimal cleaning to do after importing) about the cleaned linelist .rds; the English Case linelist section claims only that the .rds preserves column classes and makes no minimal-cleaning claim there.
findings.reader_consequence: A French reader is told the cleaned linelist needs only minimal cleaning, a guarantee the English text does not make for this dataset, and may skip cleaning checks the handbook never promised were unnecessary.
